newsitem.title: UK: LME copper firm but others on defensive.
newsitem.headline: LME copper firm but others on defensive.

text.p: COPPER - Holding just below one-year highs, underpinned by low world stock situation. ZINC - Overbought, technicians look for possible $50 correction. ALUMINIUM - Poor technicals, possible downside break of recent $1,510/$1,550 range. TIN - Pressuring Thursday's 26 months lows. NICKEL- Hesitant ahead of Inco labour contract deadline. LEAD/ALLOY - Lower.
